text:
sasha: noticed a 200-400ms tail latency spike on a few long-context streams after morning deploy, looks correlated with KV evict path under sustained paging pressure. attaching quick logs below.

jon: can you paste the deploy id and config? did we flip the eviction priority earlier?

sasha: deploy-id: deploy/2026-03-20-evict-tweak, config change was lowering reuse threshold and biasing FIFO on hot pages to reduce fragmentation.

maria: interesting — FIFO bias was supposed to reduce reorder churn. any chance we regressed correctness (stale KV reads) or just latency?

sasha: only latency so far, but repro trace shows repeated async page faults and a lot of small reinsert operations. snippet: 
```
KVPager: page_faults=1123 reuse_hits=42 reinsert_ops=789 evict_policy=FIFO_bias
KVEvict: reclaimed=1024 bytes=1.9GiB avg_latency=1.8ms spike_count=37
```

ryan: looks like we're doing many tiny evicts then reinsert for the same keyset. could be probation map churn. did the kernel selector change affect our batching?

jon: batcher didn't change for this deploy. but kernel selector now prefers small-kernel path for <=64 token windows. long-context streams are hitting >4096 so maybe we get mixed kernel transitions triggering extra KV syncs.

maria: that makes sense — switching execution kernels mid-stream can cause extra KV checkpointing. checkpointing + FIFO reinserts under pressure = thundering small ops.

sasha: repro steps I used: 1) start a long chat stream (20k tokens) 2) hammer with 50 concurrent clients 3) observe p99 rise after ~3m. can attach a flamegraph if useful.

jon: please attach flamegraph, and run a comparison with old config (LRU default) to rule out unrelated regressions.

sasha: attaching small flame excerpt inline: 
```
- kv_evict_loop 45%
  - reinsert_single 30%
  - pager_lock 10%
- kernel_switch_sync 20%
- batching_dispatch 8%
```

ryan: if pager_lock is contended that's our culprit. two quick mitigation ideas: 1) temporarily revert FIFO bias; 2) coalesce reinserts into batch op (fast path).

maria: +1 on revert, but we should also add telemetry to tag reinserts with kernel-version and stream-id so we can correlate.

infra-bot: deployment deploy/2026-03-20-evict-tweak rolled out to 40% (canary) at 2026-03-20T09:12:11Z.

sasha: reverted FIFO_bias on canary and p99 dropped back to normal within 90s. looks like bias change is the proximate cause.

jon: ok revert to LRU on stable and open a follow-up to explore a deterministic reinsertion coalescer + kernel-aware eviction hints. tag with postmortem label.

ryan: I'll prototype a batched reinsert fast-path, will instrument with counters for reinsert_batch_size and kernel_transition_count.

maria: put a short checklist for correctness: ensure reinserts keep original timestamps order, preserve tombstones, and write atomic reinsert batches.

deploy-bot: rollback deploy/2026-03-20-evict-tweak -> deploy/2026-03-19-stable completed at 2026-03-20T09:25:40Z.

sasha: thanks everyone. summary: FIFO bias on hot pages + kernel switching produced high small-reinsert rate -> pager_lock contention -> p99 latency spikes. reverting fixed immediate issue; next work: batched reinserts, kernel-aware eviction hints, more telemetry. :memo: :rocket:
